prompt.garment: a regular fit t-shirt in 240gsm wide-rib textured knit (52% cotton / 48% polyester), {COR}, the entire body and sleeves covered in raised vertical rib columns about 4–6 mm wide separated by narrow recessed grooves about 2–3 mm wide, running perfectly straight from the shoulder seam to the hem, the column widths varying slightly in an irregular rhythm, each column showing a fine horizontal stitch grain like a knitted sweater, fully matte surface, set-in shoulders, short sleeves ending mid-bicep with a turned double-stitched hem and the ribs continuing vertically down the sleeve, medium-width smooth flat crew-neck band (not ribbed) in the same color, straight double-stitched hem at the hip, fully opaque
prompt.bottom: light-wash blue jeans with ripped distressing on the thighs

prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: medium-weight 240gsm wide-rib knit with body and structure — the vertical columns act like a light internal frame, so the front hangs in long flat vertical planes and the side seams drop straight; the fabric rests on the ribs rather than clinging to the chest or stomach. Under the soft key light each raised column is lit on its top face while the grooves fall into thin shadow, producing a rhythm of parallel vertical light-and-shadow lines: on light colors they read as soft gray pinstripes, on dark colors as a subtle tone-on-tone ribbed stripe. Completely matte, no sheen. The smooth, clean collar band contrasts with the ribbed body; reinforced seams; turned double-stitched sleeve and bottom hems; anti-torsion finish keeps the ribs running perfectly vertical with no twist. Movement: folds form along the rib direction — at the armpit and waist the columns curve gently and gather into a few soft vertical pleats; where fingers pinch the sleeve, the ribs spread open like a fan and reveal the grooves, then spring back.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): body length 72 cm ending at the hip, chest width 54 cm giving 2–4 cm of relaxed ease, shoulder width 46 cm with the shoulder seam sitting exactly on the shoulder point, sleeve length 18 cm ending mid-bicep. The textured knit has little stretch, so the silhouette stays clean and regular, and the vertical ribs visually lengthen the torso.
